elements.requirement: Paragraph (b) of section 157(8) of the Local Government and Housing Act 1989 is substituted with text applying to so much of any contributions in respect of an expense incurred on or after 1st April 1989 and before 1st April 1990 as have not been made before 1st April 1990.
elements.quote: for paragraph (b) there shall be substituted the following paragraph— bso much of any contributions in respect of an expense incurred on or after 1st April 1989 and before 1st April 1990 as have not been made before 1st April 1990.
